value.description: link.v0 (D-681, D-682): what a policy says about the two things a run may ask the person while it runs. `join: forbid` makes every slot yield `joined: false` with the reason `policy` (L-33): nothing is looked at and no card is shown. `raise: forbid` means the budget-raise request is never asked (L-41): the refusal of before stands. A policy only lowers; planned links, decided at the review, are not its subject here.
